desc: 深褐板底暖垩白调吐司套图，覆盖痛点、组织对比与独立小袋规格
name: 垩白深褐烘焙早餐吐司款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规的白底式主图
深色幕布上一秒传达柔软膨松的核心利益，主图一秒法则
放大面包放久发干、组织粗糙的早餐痛点，右板给出松软解答
代入清晨餐桌自用场景，让买家看见自己的早餐
微距证明烘烤焦皮与蓬松气孔组织的真实质感
同机位双板对比蓬松细密与粗硬组织，证明口感差异
讲清独立小袋与规格信息位，消除携带与数量疑虑
并列多口味小袋让买家按喜好选择
平铺展示独立包装与随取随吃形态，降低购买风险
低角度收口镜头放大产品气场，配合按钮位促单
shots.textZone: upper closing zone with CTA button

style.backgroundSystem: warm chalk field #F2E9DB for packshots and info screens, deep roast-brown backdrop #2E1E14 for hero-benefit and closing screens, whitewashed wood #E0CDB2 for scene and trust flat lays
style.iconSystem: thin-line bakery outline icons only, single accent color #D96A3C
style.lightingSystem: soft directional bakery light, warm key around 4300-5500K, skimming light across the crust for texture, soft contact shadows only
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm artisan bakery visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of warm chalk field #F2E9DB, deep roast-brown backdrop #2E1E14, whitewashed wood surface #E0CDB2 and one persimmon-terracotta accent #D96A3C; soft directional bakery light with skimming crust highlights and soft contact shadows; modern humanist sans-serif; thin-line bakery outline icons in the single accent color; crust-side dominant product presentation with visible cut crumb and stable scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts or brush calligraphy, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no glossy plastic-looking crust rendering.
noDrift: no mixed fonts or brush calligraphy
style.presentationRules: loaf always shown crust-side dominant with visible cut crumb; stable scale across the set
style.surfaceSystem: whitewashed weathered wood #E0CDB2 and neutral oat board #F1E6D4, matte never glossy
style.typography: modern humanist sans-serif, no brush calligraphy
